selection.next_step: calibration and final review required; no active worker/model config changed

match_sampling: All general validation and broad validation containing a tuning focus label; up to four additional broad controls per source by ascending prepared image SHA-256.

protocol.timing_scope: detector.detect wall clock; excludes HTTP and input encoding
protocol.memory_scope: native RSS of this process with all compared profiles resident; not isolated per-model allocation
protocol.object_size: normalized GT area <.01 / <.1 / >=.1; unmatched FP bucketed by predicted area

http.scope: Loopback HTTP upload, local worker detection, and response; includes inference and excludes the gateway and staging network.

component_ap_protocol.input: Full component legacy validation, matched across resolutions and encoded as browser_jpeg90

limitations: Validation datasets and released checkpoints used for prior development. No new holdout or new physical captures.
Focus-enriched sample for matched detector metrics and latency. Overall metrics are not population estimates.
Android preprocessing and dim conditions use simulated transformations of the same photos.
Memory refers to a single process with both resolutions already loaded; HTTP uses a local inference worker.
Component AP comes from separate low-confidence model evaluation and cannot be combined into a single mAP.
Versions and timing are for the local experiment environment; staging runtime and hardware may differ.
